question: Should OpenClaw continue the Wave 2+ dashboard roadmap as staged bundled dashboard work, and which subitems should be pushed to external plugin, skill, or ClawHub distribution instead?
rationale: The issue spans bundled Control UI, plugin SDK, persistent state, browser sandboxing, command/data binding, and distribution boundaries that automation cannot choose safely for maintainers.

options.title: Sponsor staged bundled dashboard work
options.body: Keep the tracker open, review linked PRs and subissues in dependency order, and require explicit storage, sandbox, permission, and upgrade proof before each stage lands.

options.title: Narrow to extension APIs
options.body: Keep only missing generic plugin/widget SDK seams in OpenClaw and ask optional widgets, skills, galleries, and app bundles to prove themselves as external plugin packages or ClawHub entries first.

options.title: Pause the roadmap
options.body: Defer or close this direction if maintainers do not want bundled dashboard work in the current product cycle.

recommendation.title: Sponsor staged bundled dashboard work
recommendation.body: Keep the tracker open, review linked PRs and subissues in dependency order, and require explicit storage, sandbox, permission, and upgrade proof before each stage lands.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main ownership signal is the recently introduced Control UI plugin-tab seam and Logbook precedent that this roadmap builds on.
